## About

I am a professor of mathematics at University Salhi Ahmed, Naama. My research interests include applied and functional analysis, operator theory, stochastic analysis, partial differential equations, and scientific machine learning, including physics-informed neural networks.

This website collects my **publications**, **preprints**, **teaching materials**, and academic resources. It is intended to provide a stable point of access to my research and teaching activities.

## Research areas

- Functional analysis and operator theory
- Pseudospectra and operator matrices
- Stochastic analysis and martingales
- Partial differential equations
- Fractional and nonlocal problems
- Scientific machine learning and physics-informed neural networks
